title: KYRIE ELEISON!
html_source: Greek: “Lord have mercy” from the Catholic Mass. [Gifford]

anchor.prefix: whose mentality is the maxim: time is money. Material domination. Dominus! Lord! Where is the spirituality? Lord Jesus? Lord Salisbury? A sofa in a westend club. But the Greek!
anchor.suffix:
A smile of light brightened his darkrimmed eyes, lengthened his long lips. 

 — The Greek! he said again. Kyrios! Shining word! The vowels the Semite and the 1939#99Saxon know
